The *Ekapuṇḍarīkattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 281) is a verse biographical narrative belonging to the Therāpadāna collection within the late Khuddaka Nikāya strata [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs five translations of the poem across five different languages [SuttaCentral].
No cross-language parallels are recorded on SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. It shares six matching segments with the first volume (*Paṭhamo bhāgo*, particularly segment range §2.1–2.3) and five matching segments with the second volume (*Dutiyo bhāgo*, covering §1.4–2.4) [DharmaNexus].
